item.title: Smackdown rating for 01/23/2026
item.description: For the third week in a row, Smackdown failed to break a million in viewership, drawing 943,000 viewers, down 25,000 from the prior show. Smackdown had a 0.22 rating in 18-49, up 0.01 from last week and was the #1 show on cable television for the night.
